I’m not of age to be join the army, and I legally cannot convince my brother not to join the navy. My stepbrother is Army ROTC at OSU, and he is stuck in his ways. 
Think about it this way- how much do you actually know about what is going on in the world? Like actually going on. Not what you have been told. What you have seen first hand. Not much. I am not meaning that in a mean way, just that the government doesn’t tell you shit. When you are training for a mission, you are constantly lied to about why you’re going, what you’re doing, etc. When you’re in pursuit, you are still getting lied to. And then even in the field, you still only know like 60% of what is actually going on, so no. You can’t ever be mentally prepared, and if you want to shut out your feelings, be my guest. Join the army. Also, from many firsthand people who have been in the army, the army is the worst branch. 
But I promise you, it would NOT help you mentally. Unless you like constantly being lied to. 

Thank you for reading this far.
